title: GRANULAR (Digitone insert)
author: analoglav
description: GRANULAR 2 stereo pitch voices, two overlapping grains per pitch; AUTO CC33/34 pitch 8 bands -12,-7,-5,0,+5,+7,+12,+24; CC36 grain size 40..140 ms default 100ms; CC37 position up to +62.5ms; CC60 DRY/WET. Parameter changes latch at grain boundaries, +24/-12 buffer range verified. No custom delay/reverb; Digitone stock synth/FX untouched.
